text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...The murmuring of mountain streams, the rustling of leaves.
Simply the forest's cycle, just as it is.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Truly, one could call it living in effortless harmony with nature.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the races finally settling down,
the two of them went on a trip using the
"Hot Springs Vacation Ticket" won from the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way to the inn, we took a stroll
through the lush, nature-rich forest nearby.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san, can you feel it?
The breath of the forest.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The deep mountain breeze carries the scent of soil and leaves.
Oak, camphor, and camellia.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
From over there, a fragrant breeze.
It carries the scent of wildflowers.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And if you listen closely...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind from a bird's wingsâ
One, two, off into the sky they go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr had always been more interested
in the lush forest around it than the hot spring itself.
choice_data_list: (She looks like she's having fun from the bottom of her heart.)
(She looks like she's genuinely having fun.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Figuring her meditation would continue for a while longer,
I waited for her leisurely, but then—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, this won't do. Not like this.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This is your trip too, Trainer.
Is there anywhere you'd like to go?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was given an unexpected proposal.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There are sightseeing spots nearby, too,
and spending a good long time enjoying the inn's hot springs sounds nice as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's being considerate.
...Even so, for her, enjoying nature here is probably what's most fun.
choice_data_list: Umm... I'd like to stay here a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Well, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, actually, I was just thinking the same thing.
In that case... let us stay here a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the sun went down that day
while we were simply enjoying the surrounding nature.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful bath.
Did you enjoy it as well, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"The night breeze beckons.
...Shall we take a short walk?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent sky.
The pitch-blacker it is, the brighter the stars shine.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"The murmur of a river comes from over there.
If we go to the hill, the sky should feel much closer.
...Do you have a preference?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr is an Umamusume like the wind—unbound by worldly things and indifferent to her surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between what happened earlier today and this cautious demeanor,
it's honestly a bit unusual for her.
choice_data_list: You seem a bit different from usual today, huh?
You seem a bit different from usual today, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Than usual?
choice_data_list: I feel like... they're paying a lot of attention to us.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...That's...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Do you remember the Tenno Sho (Autumn)?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a grand stage where a truly marvelous race unfolded—one that could rightly be called the pinnacle of Yamanin Zephyr's journey.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: On that day, I became the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Into a wind so light, so swift, and above all so free,
that it made the breeze around it feel cumbersome.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It's because there was a wind that pushed my struggling back, weaving together to carry me forward.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Auspicious breeze, gentle breeze, south summer wind—
All are close, yet none quite fit.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Above all, it is your wind—
so powerful, and so warm.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That wind is still here even now.
And the more I feel it, the more precious it becomes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Like sprouting trees, like rippling waves,
like chirping little birds, like blooming wildflowers,
I hold them so dearly.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...It feels so warm beside me.
Is that why, I wonder? Why it weighs on my mind."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr turned back toward me
with a formal demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume can bring about change—
and can change themselves—by connecting with one another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A sudden gust of wind gently rustles her hair.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Then I believe it can be that way
with you as well."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Together again, we race through the turf, the earth, and the sky—
toward a greater gale."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If it's us.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since that day, I simply can't help it.
I cannot stop thinking that way."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond with Yamanin Zephyr...
